title: Pool maintenance log
intro: Pick what you did, confirm the values and save. Everything is stored in the home system.

water_test.title: Water readings
water_test.hint: Only fill in what you measured. Empty fields don't change anything.

filter_wash.title: Filter washed
filter_wash.hint: Logs the wash date. The system reminds you when the next one is due.

cell_clean.title: Chlorinator cell cleaned
cell_clean.hint: Inspection or descaling of the electrodes. The date is logged.

probe_calibration.title: pH probe calibrated
probe_calibration.hint: Calibration with the buffer solutions. The date is logged.

nothing_text: Tap one of the maintenance tiles first.
success_text: The home system has received this maintenance.
error_text: Check the internet connection and try again.
